title: STATE_MANIFEST_V1
description: Ephemeral task-scoped state packet for CONTEXT_CONTINUITY_PROTOCOL_V1 under CRYPTO_CORE_AGENT_OS_V2. A state manifest is compiled per task from fresh git/gh/connector evidence and is NEVER committed as durable doctrine. Every value here is volatile by definition; a manifest is invalid as soon as any invalidation reason applies.

example_only.description: True only in the EXAMPLE_ONLY illustration file. A real compiled manifest omits this or sets it to false.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp at which the manifest was compiled from fresh evidence.

repo.description: owner/name of the repository the evidence was proven against.

branch.description: Current local branch proven with git, never assumed.

base_sha.description: Base commit the task branched from. Volatile; re-prove before any mutation.

head_sha.description: Current head commit. Volatile; movement invalidates the manifest.

tree_sha.description: Tree object of the current head. Volatile.

changed_files.description: Exact changed paths relative to base, proven with git.

pr_number.description: Open PR number for this task, or null when no PR exists.

open_pr_count.description: Open PR count proven with gh or the GitHub connector. ONE_OPEN_PR is the default invariant.

ci_runs.description: Required check contexts and their terminal or pending conclusions. Pending is NOT_READY.

reviews.description: Review states relevant to the merge gate.

threads.description: Review threads with their blocker classification. A current valid P1/P2 is a MERGE_BLOCKER.

readiness_fingerprint.description: Opaque fingerprint of the readiness surface. Change invalidates the manifest. Never an authority to transition readiness.

connector_fingerprint.description: Opaque fingerprint of the connector surface. Change invalidates the manifest. Never an authority to transition the connector.

model_runtime_proof.description: Runtime model and effort evidence for the executing lane. Configuration evidence is labelled as such and never restated as runtime proof.

task_intent.description: Exactly one task family, chosen before any risk or complexity flag.

semantic_boundary.description: The one coherent semantic contract this task closes (MAX_SAFE_PR scope).

freshness_deadline.description: UTC timestamp after which the manifest must be recompiled even if nothing else changed.

invalidation_reasons.description: Conditions that invalidate this manifest and force recompilation from fresh evidence.
